note: Hand-written source of the chapter 17 ⚡ stage (Build B2, 17 Nov 2026). tools/build_stretch.py turns it into content/ms/stretch/x17.json. Malay: Malaysian standard first; the spoken forms (je, tau, kejap, motor, komplen, tak ada hal …) come after their standard partners and are marked (card notes begin «Spoken:»; the register pairs of 17 Nov check them). Chapter 17 affix gates (all, joined -lah too). «sudi» for the polite invitation, «Lain kali, ya?» as the soft no. Chapter 1 to 17 core words plus the chapter 17 extension words only. «takkan» and «bisnes» are left out: the register rule needs «tidak akan» and «perniagaan» taught before the card, and no core text has «tidak akan» while «perniagaan» is a ⚡ 10 word. No picture scene for chapter 17, so no Cari Benda ⚡. All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

L-1803.en: Spoken: «je» for «sahaja / saja» (Ch3), only: «Santai je.» = Just relax.
L-1803.ja: 話し言葉：«sahaja / saja»（第3課）の «je»、「〜だけ」：«Santai je.»＝気楽にね。

L-1804.en: Spoken possessive: «orang lain punya» = someone else's. (Also «punya» = to have.)
L-1804.ja: 話し言葉の所有：«orang lain punya»＝ほかの人のもの。（«punya»＝持つ、の意味も。）

L-1805.en: Spoken: «tau» for «tahu» (Ch4), to know: «Saya tak tau.» = I don't know.
L-1805.ja: 話し言葉：«tahu»（第4課）の «tau»、知っている：«Saya tak tau.»＝知らない。

L-1806.en: balas (Ch17) + -an: something in return: «sebagai balasan» = in return.
L-1806.ja: balas（第17課）+ -an：お返し：«sebagai balasan»＝お返しに。

L-1807.en: ber- + setuju (Ch17): to agree (a little more formal than «setuju»): «Isteri saya bersetuju.»
L-1807.ja: ber- + setuju（第17課）：賛成する（«setuju» より少し改まった形）：«Isteri saya bersetuju.»

L-1808.en: Formal (dress, language, an event): «makan malam formal».
L-1808.ja: フォーマルな、改まった：«makan malam formal»＝フォーマルな夕食会。

L-1809.en: Spoken: «kejap» for «sekejap» (Ch4), a moment: «Kejap, ya.» = Just a moment.
L-1809.ja: 話し言葉：«sekejap»（第4課）の «kejap»、ちょっと：«Kejap, ya.»＝ちょっと待ってね。

L-1810.en: Spoken: «komplen» (from English) for making an «aduan» (Ch12), to complain.
L-1810.ja: 話し言葉：«aduan»（第12課）をする意味の «komplen»（英語から）、文句を言う。

L-1811.en: To talk nonsense (casual, a little rude): «Merepek!» = Nonsense!
L-1811.ja: ばかなことを言う（くだけた、少し失礼な言い方）：«Merepek!»＝ばかなこと言わないで！

L-1812.ja: 話し言葉：«motosikal»（第7課）の «motor»、バイク。

L-1813.en: sangat (Ch6), said twice, in speech: very, very much.
L-1813.ja: sangat（第6課）を2回、話し言葉で：とても、とても。

L-1814.ja: 気楽な、カジュアルな：«pakaian santai»＝カジュアルな服装。

L-1815.en: sebelah (Ch7), said twice, in speech: side by side.
L-1815.ja: sebelah（第7課）を2回、話し言葉で：並んで。

L-1816.en: seronok (Ch4), said twice, in speech: Have fun! Enjoy yourselves!
L-1816.ja: seronok（第4課）を2回、話し言葉で：楽しんでね！

L-1817.en: Spoken: «Tak ada hal.» = No problem. «tak» for «tidak».
L-1817.ja: 話し言葉：«Tak ada hal.»＝問題ないよ。«tak» は «tidak»。

frames.example: Kami semua bersetuju dengan cadangan itu.
frames.meaning_en: We all agree with that suggestion.
frames.meaning_ja: 私たちはみんなその提案に賛成です。

frames.example: Saya tidak akan lupa jemputan Puan.
frames.meaning_ja: お誘いのことは忘れません。

frames.frame: Baju untuk makan malam itu ___, bukan ___.
frames.example: Baju untuk makan malam itu formal, bukan santai.
frames.meaning_en: The dress for that dinner is formal, not casual.
frames.meaning_ja: その夕食会の服装はフォーマルで、カジュアルではありません。

frames.example: Kek ini balasan untuk jemputan Puan.
frames.meaning_en: This cake is a thank-you for your invitation.
frames.meaning_ja: このケーキはお招きのお返しです。
今日はすごく、すごく暑い！

frames.meaning_en: We sit side by side in class.
frames.meaning_ja: 私たちは教室で並んで座っています。

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka, hari Sabtu ini kami mahu pergi ke pantai. Sudikah Encik ikut?
lines.en: Mr Tanaka, this Saturday we're going to the beach. Would you like to come along?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Terima kasih, Cik. Kita naik apa?
lines.en: Thank you. How are we getting there?
choices: Terima kasih. Pantai itu motor saya.
choices_en: Nonsense! I don't like the beach.
Thank you. The beach is my motorbike.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Kita naik kereta saya. Encik Rahman naik motor dia.
lines.en: We'll go in my car. Mr Rahman is going on his motorbike.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Tak ada hal. Dia suka. Santai je.
lines.en: No problem. He likes it. It's all relaxed.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Sayangnya hari Sabtu saya tidak lapang. Lain kali, ya?
lines.en: Unfortunately I'm not free on Saturday. Another time?
choices: Set! Saya tidak lapang, jadi saya pergi.
choices_en: Deal! I'm not free, so I'll go.
Nonsense! The beach has no water.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ada makan malam formal dengan bos dari Jepun. Saya mesti pergi.
lines.en: There's a formal dinner with my boss from Japan. I have to go.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Oh, kerja! Tak apa. Kalau macam tu, hari Ahad?
lines.en: Oh, work! That's fine. In that case, Sunday?
choices: Oh, kerja! Saya komplen kepada bos Encik sekarang.
Oh, formal! Encik mesti pakai seluar pendek.
choices_en: Oh, work! I'll complain to your boss right now.
Oh, formal! You must wear shorts.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Hari Ahad boleh! Tetapi kejap, ya. Saya tanya isteri saya dulu.
lines.en: Sunday works! But just a moment. I'll ask my wife first.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Isteri saya bersetuju! Kami datang hari Ahad.
lines.en: My wife agrees! We'll come on Sunday.
choices: Isteri saya tak tau saya ada isteri.
Isteri saya bersetuju, tetapi dia tidak akan datang.
choices_en: My wife doesn't know I have a wife.
My wife agrees, but she won't come.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Bagus! Seronok-seronok, ya! Tetapi balasannya, Encik belanja kopi.
lines.en: Great! Have fun! But in return, you buy the coffee.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Tak ada hal. Saya tidak akan lupa!
choices: Tak ada hal. Saya tau saya lupa.
Merepek! Kopi itu orang lain punya.
choices_en: No problem. I know I forgot.
Nonsense! That coffee is someone else's.
